locale.description: A language pack is plain JSON: copy the base pack, translate it, then commit or import it. No code changes.
locale.storage: Language packs live in the locales folder of the app data directory: outside the repository, and kept across updates.
locale.bridge: Importing language packs needs the desktop app: the browser preview has no file access.
locale.partial: Missing keys fall back to Simplified Chinese.
locale.copied: Base pack copied: translate it, save as <tag>.json, then import.
